answer: Locks are entered in sparrow, expire in ferrous, and zephyr lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 83 aliases therefore needs 162 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 150 dollars in locked collateral and another 12 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
